{"metadata":{"description":"A better approach to editing files in DSH.","id":"gh:1357244547","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-smarter-edit","slug":"Anionex/dsh-smarter-edit","topics":["ai-agents","apply-patch","code-editing","codex","codex-compatible","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","file-editing","multi-file-editing","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A better approach to editing files in DSH."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Smarter Edit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文说明"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A better file-editing tool for DeepSeek Harness.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH's native `edit` requires coding models to reconstruct exact source strings
and send both old and"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" new code through structured JSON arguments."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH Smarter Edit replaces `edit` with Codex-compatible freeform
`apply_patch`, allowing the model to"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" express code changes directly as a diff.
Its goal is to reduce editing failures and token overhead "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"created by the editor
protocol itself."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The model describes the change instead of reconstructing an exact
`old_string` / `new_string` pair."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Let the model spend its tokens on changing code, not satisfying the editor
protocol.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Coding models should solve one problem: what code should change. DSH's native
editing protocol adds "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ls should solve one problem: what code should change. DSH's native
editing protocol adds three more."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 1. Exact-string reconstruction"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Native `edit(file_path, old_string, new_string)` asks the model to regenerate
source it has already "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"read. The `old_string` must match the file:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The model chose the code change correctly, but the tool rejects it during
argument matching. Smarter"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" Edit removes the exact-string pair from the
model-facing tool and lets contextual patch hunks locat"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" the exact-string pair from the
model-facing tool and lets contextual patch hunks locate the change."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 2. Source duplication"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Exact-string editing makes the model output both the existing block and a new
block that often repea"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"diting makes the model output both the existing block and a new
block that often repeats most of it:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A patch expresses the changed lines and only the context needed to locate them:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The intended token reduction comes from less repeated old source, less repeated
unchanged source, le"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ss JSON escaping, and fewer retries after exact-match
failures. The maintainers will not publish a p"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ercentage until controlled A/B
tests produce one."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 3. Structured JSON overhead"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The model must also encode multiline source inside a schema:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Quoting, escaping, and the exact-match fields belong to the editor protocol,
not the code change. Fr"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"eeform `apply_patch` lets the model generate the editing
language itself."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Evidence from OpenAI"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"OpenAI moved `apply_patch` to a named freeform tool. Its
official model guide
reports that this chan"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ge reduced `apply_patch` failure rates by **35% in
testing** compared with JSON-formatted function c"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ced `apply_patch` failure rates by **35% in
testing** compared with JSON-formatted function calling."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The result measures `apply_patch` call failures. It does not measure task
success, SWE-bench perform"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ance, or token savings. It shows that the input format
of an editing tool measurably affects reliabi"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" or token savings. It shows that the input format
of an editing tool measurably affects reliability."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Evidence of exact-string fragility"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Literal replacement succeeds only when `old_string` reproduces the target
exactly. Public Claude Cod"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"e issue reports show how tabs, line endings, and other
invisible details can turn a valid code chang"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"e into
`String to replace not found in file`:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- #13152 reports tabs
appearing as spaces in read output, followed by exact-match edit failures.
- #"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"28831 reports
unreliable multiline matching on CRLF files with tab indentation and
identifies read f"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ormatting as one possible cause.
- #54876 reports LF
read output against CRLF file contents.
- #4047"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"1 reports a
repeated edit-fail, retry, and Python/Bash fallback cycle on tab-indented
files."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"These reports describe another coding tool and do not establish DSH behavior.
They expose the underl"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ying weakness of literal replacement: the model must
reproduce file details that are unrelated to th"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"e intended code change. Any
difference can reject the edit and trigger retries or fallback tools."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Additional capabilities"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Besides changing the editing tool exposed to the model, Smarter Edit supports:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- multiple ordered hunks;
- add, update, move, and delete operations;
- Codex-compatible contextual "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"matching;
- failure-atomic preflight and rollback;
- native DSH diff rendering."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Install the current npm release into a Desktop Profile:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Use `web` or `headless` instead of `desktop` for those Profiles. Restart the
running Profile and cre"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ate a new Session after installation."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Verify that the bundle is mounted:"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"1. The model sends a patch between `*** Begin Patch` and `*** End Patch`.
2. Smarter Edit validates "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"the complete patch, locates each change from its
context, and applies it through the active DSH sand"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"box. A handled failure
rolls back published changes.
3. DSH stores the raw patch and renders the res"},{"id":"p43s4","text":"ult with its native diff view."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"The plugin removes model-visible `edit`, `write`, and legacy
`str_replace_editor` plus their prompt "},{"id":"p44s2","text":"sections while replacement mode is
active. Unloading it restores the original tools."},{"id":"p45s1","text":"## Compatibility and limitations"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"- DSH `>=0.1.1-rc.1 <0.2.0 || >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`.
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` for package dev"},{"id":"p46s2","text":"elopment and direct engine use.
- `desktop`, `web`, and `headless` Profiles.
- Write permission from"},{"id":"p46s3","text":" the active DSH sandbox. `workspace-write` keeps its
configured boundary; `danger-full-access` can a"},{"id":"p46s4","text":"llow absolute and
parent-relative paths outside it.
- Rollback on handled failures protects file sta"},{"id":"p46s5","text":"te, not retry cost. If one hunk
in a large patch fails, the whole patch is rejected and a retry must"},{"id":"p46s6","text":" submit
the full patch again.
- A broad patch can change or delete several files. Review the request"},{"id":"p46s7","text":"ed patch
and the resulting diff when a change has a large scope."},{"id":"p47s1","text":"The project is pre-1.0. Compatibility targets the declared DSH `0.1.x` and `0.2.x` ranges;
release v"},{"id":"p47s2","text":"erification installs the tarball into a clean Profile."},{"id":"p48s1","text":"## Security and community"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"- Report vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md.
- Get usage help through SUPPORT.md.
- Propo"},{"id":"p49s2","text":"se changes through CONTRIBUTING.md and the
issue tracker.
- Read release history in CHANGELOG.md.
- "},{"id":"p49s3","text":"Community participation follows the Code of Conduct."},{"id":"p50s1","text":"Maintained by Anionex under the
MIT License."}],"truncated":true}
